name: Tofu Wrap with Curried Pineapple-Apricot Chutney & Mixed Greens
instructions: Cut tofu in half along the long side. Sandwich tofu between clean towels or paper towels and place on a baking sheet pan. Place a cutting board with something heavy on top and set aside to press out excess water.
Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Cut off skin from pineapple; quarter, core, and small dice the flesh. Place half in a small saucepan. (Place the remaining pineapple in a medium bowl and set aside for later use.)
Small dice apricots and add to the pan with the pineapple.

Add water, vinegar, sugar, and spices to the pan. Stir to combine the chutney and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat. Once simmering, reduce heat to low and cook, stirring occasionally, until thickened, 8-10 minutes. Remove from heat.
Meanwhile, preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
While the skillet heats up, medium dice tofu and place in another medium bowl. Sprinkle with cornstarch, salt, and pepper; toss to coat.
Once the skillet is hot, add oil and swirl to coat the bottom. Add tofu and cook, turning every few minutes, until golden brown and crispy, about 10 minutes. Remove from heat.
While the tofu is cooking, add oil, vinegar, maple syrup, salt, and pepper to the bowl with the pineapple. Stir to combine the salad dressing.
Shave cilantro leaves off the stems; discard stems and mince the leaves. Add to the bowl with the dressing, along with the mixed greens, and toss to combine the salad. Set aside.
Warm tortillas in a skillet, oven, or microwave (optional).
Place tortillas on a flat surface; spread each with a layer of mayo and chutney. Top with tofu and a small portion of salad. Roll tightly to close. (Reserve remaining salad for serving.)
Cut wraps in half and divide between plates. Serve with remaining salad on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
